evidence_policy: Static evidence does not prove actual reference consultation, human evaluation, workflow execution, or installed-runtime behavior. Runtime claims require installed-runtime observation.

requirements.note: Static verification proves implementation contract presence, package structure, reference packaging, and/or routing declarations only. It does not prove runtime execution or consultation.
